data.summary: The workspace directory is the frontend page layer for the sandbox-manager (mgr-web) 'workspace' screen — the UI that lists registered sandboxes, expands their manifest buttons, and opens panes, menus and dialogs. It combines presentational components (SandboxTree.tsx, NodeMenu.tsx, RegisterDialog.tsx) with shared type/decoder definitions (types.ts) and pure URL-resolution logic (paneUrl.ts) that bridges the legacy workbench SPA origin model to mgr's per-sandbox proxy/gateway topology. All data fetching and state live in the parent WorkspacePage; these files consume props and expose small, well-typed helpers.

file_insights.name: SandboxTree.tsx
file_insights.summary: Presentational left-rail tree component rendering one node per registered sandbox with live-state badges and lazily fetched manifest-button children.
file_insights.source_summary: Declares ManifestState and Props interfaces plus liveKey/liveCls helpers that translate live-status strings into 'stRunning' | 'stStopped' | 'stGone' | 'stUnknown' keys and class names. The main SandboxTree function renders sandbox nodes with status badges, inline start actions, and expandable manifest-button children driven entirely by props and callbacks.
file_insights.detailed_description: SandboxTree.tsx implements the workspace page's left navigation rail (design §2.2): a node per registered sandbox showing a live-state badge and an inline start button when stopped, with manifest buttons as lazily-expanded children fetched through mgr's per-sandbox proxy. It is strictly presentational — the sandbox list, manifest cache, expanded set and all fetches are owned by WorkspacePage and passed down as props, mirroring the App + Sidebar split in the legacy web/src SPA. It also exports small helpers (liveKey, liveCls) that map backend live-state strings to presentation keys and CSS classes.
responsibilities: Render one tree node per registered sandbox with live-state badge
Expose inline start action for stopped sandboxes
Lazily render manifest buttons as children on expand/refresh
Map raw live-state values to presentation keys and CSS classes

file_insights.name: paneUrl.ts
file_insights.summary: Pure utility module resolving per-sandbox pane URLs (code-server, VNC, preview ports, terminal WebSocket) against mgr's per-sandbox gateway origin.
file_insights.source_summary: Exports browserPort() to read the current mgr port, withMgrPort(url) to rewrite a URL onto that port, sandboxGatewayOrigin(sandbox) to build the sbx-<name>.mgr.localhost origin, urlFor(service, sandbox) to resolve a ServiceEntry to a concrete pane URL (or undefined), and termWsUrl(sandbox, cmd, cwd) to build the terminal WebSocket URL.
file_insights.detailed_description: paneUrl.ts is the single place that decouples workbench pane URLs from the mgr.localhost origin the original workbench SPA assumed (web/src treated everything as same-origin). It encodes four routing rules: relative gateway paths (/code-server/, /vnc/...) become http://sbx-<name>.mgr.localhost + path so the sandbox's own gateway strips the prefix and reverse-proxies; /preview/<port>/ user web buttons are rewritten through mgr's /api/sbx/ proxy; and terminal connections get a WebSocket URL. It carries low complexity but high architectural leverage since all panes depend on its correctness.
responsibilities: Derive the sandbox-specific gateway origin from a sandbox name
Map relative gateway service paths to per-sandbox hosts
Rewrite /preview/<port> button URLs through mgr's per-sandbox proxy
Construct terminal WebSocket URLs with command and cwd parameters

file_insights.name: types.ts
file_insights.summary: Shared type definitions and runtime decoders mirroring the sandbox backend's /api/manifest and /api/buttons payload contracts.
file_insights.source_summary: Defines the ServiceType and RegisterButtonType aliases and the ServiceEntry, Manifest and RegisterButtonInput interfaces. Exports isServiceEntry(v) as a type-guard for individual service entries and decodeManifest(json) to validate and normalize an unknown JSON payload into a typed Manifest.
file_insights.detailed_description: types.ts is the boundary owner for the workspace page's manifest contract, ported from the deprecated web/src/types.ts workbench SPA. It declares ServiceEntry, Manifest, RegisterButtonInput and related aliases that mirror the sandbox app's Rust types (app/src/config.rs ManifestEntry, app/src/routes/buttons.rs ButtonInput/ButtonOut) exactly, reached through mgr's per-sandbox proxy /api/sbx/:name/*. It also provides defensive runtime validators (isServiceEntry, decodeManifest) so untrusted JSON from the proxy is narrowed safely before use.
responsibilities: Define shared manifest/button data contracts for the workspace page
Provide a runtime type guard for ServiceEntry values
Decode and validate raw manifest JSON at the API boundary
Keep frontend types in sync with the Rust backend payload shapes

file_insights.name: RegisterDialog.tsx
file_insights.summary: Modal form component for registering custom user buttons against a selected sandbox via POST /api/buttons through mgr's per-sandbox proxy.
file_insights.source_summary: Declares the Props interface and exports the RegisterDialog function component (taking onRegister and returning JSX) plus a close() helper. The component renders the button-registration form fields, conditionally mounts the overlay, and dispatches the POST /api/buttons request through the per-sandbox proxy.
file_insights.detailed_description: RegisterDialog.tsx implements the modal form used to register custom buttons (design D7), ported from the Phase 2 web/src/RegisterDialog.tsx with two mgr-web adaptations: dialogs are conditionally rendered rather than mounted/unmounted with a CSS visibility transition, so fields reset naturally on each mount, and submission goes to POST /api/buttons on the selected sandbox through mgr's per-sandbox proxy. It validates user input, manages submit/error state, and closes via an onRegister callback upward.
responsibilities: Render the user-registered button creation form
Submit registration payloads to POST /api/buttons via the sandbox proxy
Reset form fields on each conditional mount
Report success/closure upward through onRegister

file_insights.name: NodeMenu.tsx
file_insights.summary: Fixed-positioned 'more' menu for a sandbox tree node, offering terminal, manage, start/stop/restart, config edit and custom-button registration actions.
file_insights.source_summary: Defines the NodeMenuIcon type alias and a Props interface, then a single component function that renders the fixed-position dropdown menu with live-state-aware enabled/disabled actions wired to callback props. Includes a11y markup for the menu and its items.
file_insights.detailed_description: NodeMenu.tsx renders the per-node overflow menu for the sandbox tree (prototype workspace.html .menu), positioned fixed so the side panel cannot clip it. It exposes actions that are delegated upward: open a terminal (launches the sandbox terminal service), view the sandbox in the list (onManage), start/stop/restart (sandboxAction, owned by WorkspacePage), edit config (App-level navigation) and register a custom button (opens RegisterDialog). Disabled states track live sandbox state — a stopped sandbox cannot open panes or be stopped again — and accessibility attributes are included.
responsibilities: Render the fixed-position node overflow menu
Dispatch terminal, manage, start/stop/restart, config and register actions
Compute disabled states from live sandbox state
Provide accessible menu semantics (aria roles/labels)
